title: stuckenia filiformis var. alpina
intro: Stuckenia filiformis var. alpina, commonly known as Alpine Water-Plantain, is a perennial aquatic plant that belongs to the family Potamogetonaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic properties, which include reducing inflammation and pain, as well as treating respiratory issues such as bronchitis and coughs. The health benefits of Alpine Water-Plantain include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can help to protect against oxidative stress, infections, and diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions.
